messages:
maria_pm: Quick sync — Customer X asked for a clearer pinning + migration playbook. They want options (hard pin, soft auto-migrate, incentives). Need a proposed roadmap + launch criteria by EOD Friday. Anyone?

aj_devex: I can put together a devex migration guide. What exact acceptance gates do we want to enforce? latency/cost/quality?

liam_eng: From infra: perf gates first. Target: perf delta <= 15% on p95 and memory footprint <= current -10% for any quantized variant, otherwise we need to keep dedicated capacity. Also surface error-rate thresholds.

sara_ml: Quality gate: run end-to-end eval on ~500 representative prompts. Use a mix of automated metrics + small human panel. Flag hallucination rate (target < 0.05) and coherence / instruction-following drop < 5%.

maria_pm: OK so summary gates = perf (p95), mem, quality (eval/human). For migration incentives: thinking credits + extended pin grace (30d) or a concierge-assisted migration for strategic customers. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

nate_support: Support constraints: migration must include explicit rollback path, opt-out mechanism, and a comms template. We also need an ops checklist for emergency rollback.

aj_devex: Proposed lanes:
- Fast-path: customer requests assisted pin for 90d + migration aid.
- Soft-path: auto-migrate after 60d notice with opt-out.
- Canary: 10% traffic cohort for 2 weeks then ramp on success.

liam_eng: We can automate the canary via routing policies. Need new route config fields: model_version, weight, rollback_threshold. Example config snippet:
```json
{"model_version":"v2.1-q8","weight":0.1,"rollback_threshold":{"error_rate":0.02,"latency_p95_ms":200}}
```

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for model v2.1-q8 on cohort 'onboard-early' — canary_id=canary-2026-03-12-01

maria_pm: :thumbsup: Good. What timeline for perf + quality measurements?

liam_eng: I can run the perf sweeps in ~48h and produce p95/cost deltas. Then integrate those into the routing experiment pipeline.

sara_ml: I will assemble the 500-prompt eval set and coordinate a 20-person human panel. Need product to surface 50 customer-critical prompts we must include.

maria_pm: @nate_support please prep comms + opt-out template. @aj_devex please draft the migration docs and include example customer snippets.

nate_support: On it. We'll also recommend a 7-day rollback SLA for customers who opt into fast-path. Need list of affected tenant contacts.

aj_devex: Drafting now. Example opt-in snippet for customers:
```python
client.pin_model('customer-id', model='v2.1-q8', ttl_days=30)
```

maria_pm: Action items: liam -> perf sweep (48h), sara -> eval (72h), aj -> docs + snippet (EOD), nate -> comms + rollback SLA (EOD). Let's reconvene tomorrow 10:00am PT. Thanks everyone!
